answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 11449 Country: India Title: Asalamoalaikum. If after purity, a female gets brownish fluid or sme blood in menstruation, shud she pray? Question: Asalamoalaikum. If after purity, a female gets brownish fluid or sme blood in menstruation, shud she pray? Answer ID: 11449 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 386/357=B/1430) Yes, she will perform salah after doing wudhu. If some fluid is discharged after the completion of menstruation cycle, it also has the same ruling. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
